fields.body_md:
## At a glance

The University of Melbourne is a public university in Melbourne, Victoria. Its main campus is in Parkville. This page uses two of its two-year master's courses to show real costs and entry rules.

The most important fact is the fee. For a student starting in 2027, the Master of Information Technology costs **AUD 68,480** in the first year. The Master of Data Science costs **AUD 61,440**. The visa also needs living money, so the first year costs more than the fee alone.

| | Master of Information Technology | Master of Data Science |
|---|---|---|
| Campus | Parkville, on campus | Parkville, on campus |
| Length | 2 years full time | 2 years full time |
| Intakes | March and July | March |
| First-year fee, 2027 | **AUD 68,480** | **AUD 61,440** |
| Fee for the whole course, 2027 | **AUD 143,808** | **AUD 129,024** |
| English test (IELTS) | **6.5** overall, no part below **6.0** | **6.5** overall, no part below **6.0** |
| CRICOS course code | 077475F | 092791B |

CRICOS is the Australian government list of courses that may teach overseas students. Each course page also lists the fee for 2026. This page uses 2027 because that is the year you would start.

## What it really costs

The fee is only one part of the money. The Australian student visa asks you to show enough money for three things. They are your first-year course fee, 12 months of living costs and your travel. Read the [Australia proof of funds guide](/study-abroad/study-in/australia/australia-student-visa-proof-of-funds) for the full rules.

The sums below use the Home Affairs figures: living costs of **AUD 29,710** and travel of **AUD 2,000**. The student visa charge is **AUD 2,500**.

| Item | Master of Information Technology | Master of Data Science |
|---|---|---|
| First-year course fee, 2027 | AUD 68,480 | AUD 61,440 |
| Living costs for 12 months (visa rule) | AUD 29,710 | AUD 29,710 |
| Travel (visa rule) | AUD 2,000 | AUD 2,000 |
| **Money to show for the visa** | **AUD 100,190** | **AUD 93,150** |
| Student visa charge | AUD 2,500 | AUD 2,500 |
| **Total before health cover** | **AUD 102,690** | **AUD 95,650** |

At ₹61.80 per AUD, the totals are about **₹63.46 lakh** and **₹59.11 lakh**. The rate is the Reserve Bank of Australia rate for 27 November 2026. It changes every day, so use the [rupee transfer calculator](/study-abroad/tools/rbi-lrs-tcs-calculator) before you send money.

Three limits apply to these totals.

- **Health cover is not included.** Students must hold Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC), which is health insurance for international students. We have not found an official price, so we leave it out.
- **The second year costs more or less.** The university gives the first-year fee and the whole-course total. It does not give the second-year fee.
- **Living costs may be higher.** The visa figure is a minimum. Melbourne rents are in our [cost of living guide](/study-abroad/study-in/australia/australia-cost-of-living-for-indian-students).

## Ways to reduce the cost

Melbourne offers two scholarships that cut tuition by 20%. Both are for master's coursework students with an overseas-fee offer. You do not apply separately. The university considers you when you apply for a course.

| Scholarship | What it gives | Who can get it |
|---|---|---|
| Melbourne International Graduate Scholarship | **20%** off tuition for the whole course | Citizens of countries with GDP per capita of **US$10,000** or less. India is on the list. At least **300** awards. |
| Melbourne International Excellence Scholarship (Graduate) | **20%** off tuition for the whole course | Any international student with a master's offer. At least **180** awards. |

Winners are the applicants with the highest course entry scores. A winner hears within **five working days** of the course offer. You cannot hold this scholarship with another one that gives a fee discount.

For the Master of Information Technology, 20% of the 2027 first-year fee is **AUD 13,696**. That would leave **AUD 54,784**. For the Master of Data Science, 20% is **AUD 12,288**, which would leave **AUD 49,152**. These are our sums, not the university's. The university cannot promise the award before it makes an offer, so plan your visa money on the full fee.

The Australian government also runs the Australia Awards for India. Its applications are closed now. Our [scholarships page](/study-abroad/study-in/australia/scholarships) lists the details.

## Getting in

Melbourne decides places by your past marks. The course pages say the selection method is prior academic performance. For the Master of Information Technology, the page also names relevance of previous study.

| Course | Degree needed | Other rules |
|---|---|---|
| Master of Information Technology (2 years) | A bachelor degree in any subject, with a weighted average mark of **65%** or equivalent | One computer programming subject at university level |
| Master of Information Technology (1.5 years) | A bachelor degree with a major in computer science, IT, software engineering or a related subject, with **65%** or equivalent | No extra subject listed |
| Master of Data Science (2 years) | A bachelor degree in any subject, with **65%** or equivalent | A programming subject, plus Calculus 2 and Linear Algebra or equivalents |

The weighted average mark (WAM) is your average mark across your degree. Its [grade conversion calculator](https://study.unimelb.edu.au/how-to-apply/graduate-coursework-study/grade-conversion-eligibility-calculator) gives an indicative score in your own university's grading scale. Melbourne says to use it as a guide only.

**Important for Indian graduates.** Have you already studied at a university in India? Melbourne's India page says you must then apply through one of its authorised education agents. The page says the agents are free for you.

**English.** Both courses ask for IELTS **6.5** overall with no part below **6.0**. The pages also list TOEFL **81** and Pearson **64**.

## Deadlines

| Course | Intake | Applications due (international) |
|---|---|---|
| Master of Information Technology | Start of 2027 | **2 January 2027** |
| Master of Information Technology | July 2027 | **31 May 2027** |
| Master of Data Science | March 2027 | Late applications accepted until **2 January 2027** |

Apply as early as you can. The university says places are limited and you cannot defer an offer for these courses. Its India page gives a typical wait of **4 to 8 weeks** for a decision. For Master of Data Science, the course page says it aims to give outcomes within **6 to 8 weeks**.

## Popular programs for Indian students

- [Master of Information Technology at Melbourne](/study-abroad/program-detail/australia/university-of-melbourne/melbourne-master-of-information-technology). Two years, with optional choices in artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, distributed computing and human-computer interaction.
- [Master of Data Science at Melbourne](/study-abroad/program-detail/australia/university-of-melbourne/melbourne-master-of-data-science). Two years, with a capstone project and four specialisation choices.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- you hold a bachelor degree with a weighted average mark of 65% or equivalent
- you can apply through an authorised education agent
- you can show AUD 93,150 to AUD 100,190 for the visa

**Think carefully if:**

- your English score is below IELTS 6.5 overall or 6.0 in any part
- you cannot cover a second year at a fee that is not yet published
- you want to start in March 2027, because the January 2027 dates are close

## Sources

Checked on 28 November 2026:

- [Master of Information Technology, University of Melbourne](https://study.unimelb.edu.au/find/courses/graduate/master-of-information-technology/)
- [Master of Data Science, University of Melbourne](https://study.unimelb.edu.au/find/courses/graduate/master-of-data-science/)
- [Study at Melbourne: information for students from India](https://study.unimelb.edu.au/connect-with-us/international/india)
- [Melbourne International Graduate Scholarship](https://scholarships.unimelb.edu.au/awards/melbourne-international-graduate-scholarship), [Melbourne International Excellence Scholarship (Graduate)](https://scholarships.unimelb.edu.au/awards/melbourne-international-excellence-scholarship-graduate) and [eligible countries](https://scholarships.unimelb.edu.au/eligible-countries)
- [Grade conversion eligibility calculator](https://study.unimelb.edu.au/how-to-apply/graduate-coursework-study/grade-conversion-eligibility-calculator)
- [Australia Awards, India (applications closed)](https://australiaawardsindia.org/opportunities/)
- [Student visa (subclass 500), Department of Home Affairs](https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/getting-a-visa/visa-listing/student-500)
- [Exchange rates, Reserve Bank of Australia](https://www.rba.gov.au/statistics/frequency/exchange-rates.html)

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much does a master's at the University of Melbourne cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: For a 2027 start, the first-year fee is AUD 68,480 for Master of Information Technology and AUD 61,440 for Master of Data Science. The whole courses cost AUD 143,808 and AUD 129,024.

faq_json.q: How much money must I show for the Australian student visa to study at Melbourne?
faq_json.a: For Master of Information Technology the sum is AUD 100,190: the AUD 68,480 fee, AUD 29,710 living costs and AUD 2,000 travel. For Master of Data Science it is AUD 93,150.

faq_json.q: Do Indian students need an agent to apply to the University of Melbourne?
faq_json.a: Yes, if you have already studied at a university in India. Melbourne's India page says you must apply through an authorised education agent. The page says the agent costs you nothing.

faq_json.q: What marks do I need for a master's at Melbourne?
faq_json.a: Both courses ask for a weighted average mark of 65% or equivalent. Melbourne's grade conversion calculator gives an indicative score in your own grading scale. It is a guide only.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score does Melbourne need for these master's courses?
faq_json.a: IELTS 6.5 overall with no part below 6.0 for both courses. The pages also list TOEFL 81 and Pearson 64.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students at Melbourne?
faq_json.a: Yes. The Melbourne International Graduate Scholarship gives 20% off tuition and India is on its eligible country list. You are considered automatically when you apply.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for the 2027 intake at Melbourne?
faq_json.a: For Master of Information Technology, international applications are due 2 January 2027 for the start of the year and 31 May 2027 for July. Master of Data Science accepts late applications until 2 January 2027.
